segments.sn4.4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
segments.sn4.4:2.1: “Mayhaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikārā yoniso sammappadhānā anuttarā vimutti anuppattā, anuttarā vimutti sacchikatā.
segments.sn4.4:2.2: Tumhepi, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikārā yoniso sammappadhānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ anupāpuṇātha, anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchikarothā”ti.
segments.sn4.4:2.3: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.4:5.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā … pe … tatthevantaradhāyīti.

lines: Ajjhabhāsīti “ayaṃ attanā vīriyaṃ katvā arahattaṃ patvāpi na tussati, idāni aññesampi ‘pāpuṇāthā’ti ussāhaṃ karoti, paṭibāhessāmi nan”ti cintetvā abhāsi.
Ye dibbā ye ca mānusāti ye dibbā kāmaguṇasaṅkhātā mānusā kāmaguṇasaṅkhātā ca mārapāsā nāma atthi, sabbehi tehi tvaṃ baddhoti vadati.
Na me samaṇa mokkhasīti samaṇa tvaṃ mama visayato na muccissasi.
Kilesamāro hi satte kāmaguṇapāsehi nibandhati, na pana sayameva.

Na me samaṇa mokkhasīti idaṃ māro “anuttarā vimutti anuppattā, vimuttā sabbapāsehī”ti ca bhagavato vacanaṃ asaddahanto vadati saddahantopi vā “evamayaṃ paresaṃ sattānaṃ mokkhāya ussāhaṃ na kareyyā”ti attano kohaññe ṭhatvā vadati.

before.title: Paṭhamamārapāsasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Anuppannapāpakānuppādanādiatthāni hi vīriyāni yadatthaṃ honti, taṃ atthaṃ sādhentiyevāti etassa atthassa dīpako sammā-saddo.
Yonisosammāsaddena hi upāyakāraṇatthadīpakataṃ sandhāya “upāyavīriyena kāraṇavīriyenā”ti vuttaṃ.
Mārena “mayhaṃ kho, bhikkhave”tiādikaṃ bhagavato vacanaṃ sutvā vuttaṃ “arahattaṃ patvāpi na tussatī”tiādi.
